note: Small USFS campground (Divide RD, Rio Grande NF) straddling Cross Creek just above the Beaver Reservoir inlet, ~6.4 mi up Beaver Creek Rd (FR 20, gravel after 4 mi) from US 160 west of South Fork. No amenities outside the concessionaire season; pack out trash. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 8 sites, 25-ft max spur (not all sites), vault toilet, no water, first-come only (no recreation.gov listing), 14-day limit, Divide RD phone 719-657-3321. Added season (open year-round, concession Memorial Day-Labor Day), fees $10 shoulder / $27 summer (high 34 -> 27; the page's $34 'with hookup' line kept in fees.note and flagged), senior/access discount. Pin = the FS page's coordinates. FR 20 is paved 4 mi then gravel; no road alert for it (Beaver Creek Recreation Area has a use-restriction order, not a closure). Note trimmed.
flags: Fees: the FS page lists 'Single Site with Hookup: $34 per night' but describes no hookups (vault toilet, no water); the stored note-derived electric 0 / no water / no sewer was left. Probably copied boilerplate; the high is recorded as the $27 single-site rate.

Rig length: 'turn around and parking space for trailers is limited' singles this campground out, but the same page states 'Maximum spur length is 25 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.' The stated 25 ft (23 ft+) outranks the wording, so not a CRITERIA problem; a 23-ft rig fits only some of the 8 sites.
Forest order: 'Beaver Creek Recreation Area Use Restrictions' (Rio Grande NF alerts) restricts camping, parking and dogs in the area - not a closure.
